<b>Pendras</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are flighty masked insects from [[Verdania]] that live beside still waters.<ref>Pendra Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Flighty insect that lives beside still waters. Though generally passive, their sharp masks can cause injury if carelessly blundered into."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Pendras are non-hostile flying enemies that hover over bodies of water, flying to a new position and pausing, never staying still for more than a second. Despite their lack of hostility, they still deal {{Damage|1}} contact damage.

The second Pendra in the first room of [[Lost Verdania]] has 35 HP; all other Pendras have 22 HP.

== Location ==
Pendras can be found in [[Lost Verdania]].

== Trivia ==
* Pendras do not respond to the [[Needolin]].
* Pendras were [[Cut Content (Hollow Knight)#Miscellaneous Unused Assets|originally intended]] to appear in <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i>, but were cut.
* The silhouette of a Pendra can be seen flying in the foreground of the Lost Verdania habitat in the Memorium, and near the water in Moss Grotto and Weavenest Atla.
